# Create the new public playlist, add all unique liked song_ids, then fetch its shareable link.
# (Action-only block; no message sending here.)

spotify_access_token = spotify_token['access_token']

# 1) Create playlist (public)
create_res = apis.spotify.create_playlist(title=playlist_title, access_token=spotify_access_token, is_public=True)
print('create_playlist response:', create_res)

playlist_id = create_res.get('playlist_id') if isinstance(create_res, dict) else None
print('playlist_id:', playlist_id)

# 2) Add songs
song_add_results = []
for idx, sid in enumerate(union_song_ids):
    try:
        r = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_access_token)
        song_add_results.append((sid, 'ok', r))
    except Exception as e:
        song_add_results.append((sid, 'fail', str(e)))

ok_count = sum(1 for x in song_add_results if x[1] == 'ok')
fail_count = sum(1 for x in song_add_results if x[1] == 'fail')
print('add_song_to_playlist ok:', ok_count, 'fail:', fail_count)
print('first 5 failures:', [x for x in song_add_results if x[1]=='fail'][:5])

# 3) Fetch playlist details to get shareable link
pl_res = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=spotify_access_token)
print('show_playlist response keys:', list(pl_res.keys()) if isinstance(pl_res, dict) else type(pl_res))

shareable_link = pl_res.get('shareable_link') if isinstance(pl_res, dict) else None
print('shareable_link:', shareable_link)

# Basic verification: ensure link exists and at least 1 song added
print('playlist title in show_playlist:', pl_res.get('title') if isinstance(pl_res, dict) else None)
try:
    songs_in_playlist = pl_res.get('songs', [])
    print('songs_in_playlist count:', len(songs_in_playlist))
except Exception:
    print('Could not read songs count from show_playlist')
